title: Attachment composer
description: Let attachments enter and leave a message without displacing the writing task.
useCase: Let attachments enter and leave a message without displacing the writing task.
interaction: Attach a file and send a note
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Files remain local names only. The submit action prepares a local state and sends nothing.
look: White rounded composer card on light warm grey with a bordered file chip, system-font message text, a plus icon and a round blue send button.
motion: Attaching a file through the plus button makes its chip rise 5 px and fade in over 200 ms (ease-out); removal and send happen instantly.
adapt: The chip entrance is the `sf-attachment-composer-attachmentIn` keyframe on `.file` (200 ms); tune its offset and duration there. Replace the `files` and `text` seed state and the `onSubmit` handler, which only sets `sent`, with your upload and send logic.
